title: Finite flat model in regular local dimension two
statement: Let A be a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] with Krull dimension two [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let U be the complement of the closed point in Spec A [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and q:Y → U a finite etale morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. There exist a locally Noetherian scheme F and a finite flat map r:F → Spec A [def-weil-flat-morphism] such that every stalk at a point outside r⁻¹(U) has depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth], together with an isomorphism Y ≅ r⁻¹(U) over U.

source.place: Tag 0BMA, pione-lemma-purity-regular, dimension-two paragraph up to flatness; Tag 0BM9, pione-lemma-reformulate-purity-normal

proof.text: The only boundary point is the closed point. Its stalk is ring-isomorphic to A by Mathlib stalkClosedPointIso. Transfer regularity and dimension, choose minimal generators of the maximal ideal, and use the regular-generator theorem to obtain a regular sequence. Its length occurs in the supremum defining depth, giving boundary depth at least two. The Lean private helper spells out the supremum argument.

Apply the depth-two finite extension theorem to q, obtaining a finite r, the source boundary depth bound, and an isomorphism from its restriction to Y. The restriction is etale because it is isomorphic over U to q.

Apply the supplied-model flatness theorem for a regular local surface to r. Since r is finite over the Noetherian affine target, its source is locally Noetherian. Retain the source depth bound and invert the restriction isomorphism; composition with its inverse proves the displayed equation over U.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_flat_model_of_regular_local_dimension_two (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite q] [Etale q] : ∃ (F : Scheme.{u}) (r : F ⟶ Spec (.of A)), IsLocallyNoetherian F ∧ IsFinite r ∧ Flat r ∧ (∀ x : F, x ∉ r ⁻¹ᵁ U → (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := F.presheaf.stalk x) (F.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧ ∃ e : Y ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, e.hom ≫ r ∣_ U = q
